description: This file defines the GuardrailsAI class, which extends CustomGuardrail to implement guardrail functionality for language model calls, including making API requests to GuardrailsAI, processing input messages, and handling pre- and post-call hooks. It manages interactions with the GuardrailsAI service, validates API responses, and integrates with a larger system for ensuring guardrail policies are enforced during LLM operations.

classes.name: GuardrailsAI
classes.description: A class extending CustomGuardrail, implementing methods to send requests to GuardrailsAI API for validation, process input messages, and integrate guardrail checks into LLM call workflows.

methods.name: GuardrailsAIResponse make_guardrails_ai_api_request( self, llm_output: str, request_data: dict )
methods.description: Makes an asynchronous POST request to the GuardrailsAI validation API with the LLM output and request data, returning the validation response or raising HTTPException on failure.

methods.name: str make_guardrails_ai_api_request_pre_call_request( self, text_input: str, request_data: dict )
methods.description: Makes an API request to GuardrailsAI to validate input text before a call, returning the validated output or raising an HTTPException if the guardrail policy is violated.

methods.name: dict process_input(self, data: dict, call_type: str)
methods.description: Processes message data during completion calls, optionally validating or modifying the last user message using GuardrailsAI, based on configuration.

methods.name: Optional[Union[Exception,str,dict]] async_pre_call_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, cache: litellm.DualCache, data: dict, call_type: Literal[ "completion", "text_completion", "embeddings", "image_generation", "moderation", "audio_transcription", "pass_through_endpoint", "rerank", "mcp_call", ], )
methods.description: Pre-call hook that validates or processes request data asynchronously before calling the language model.

methods.name: Tuple[dict,Any] async_logging_hook( self, kwargs: dict, result: Any, call_type: str )
methods.description: Logs or processes data and results asynchronously during the call workflow.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response, )
methods.description: Post-call hook to process the response, potentially validating or logging the response after an LLM call.

methods.name: Optional[Type["GuardrailConfigModel"]] get_config_model()
methods.description: Returns the configuration model class for this guardrail, if applicable.

methods.name: __init__( self, guard_name: str, api_base: Optional[str] = None, guardrails_ai_api_input_format: Literal["inputs", "llmOutput"] = "llmOutput", **kwargs, )
